meta.name: vois-loop
meta.description: Iterative design build loop for the Vois design system. Wraps design-ask, vois-router, and the full skill chain (vois-patterns, vois-components, vois-tokens, righter, design-rationale) in a loop that detects conflicts between skills and routes back upstream when something doesn't resolve cleanly. Includes an inline validation pass (no external skill required) that checks implementation correctness before design-rationale closes the loop. Use this as the single entry point for any feature build that starts from a ticket, brief, or raw description. Trigger when someone says "build this", pastes a ticket, or asks to run the full design loop.
